Definition: to admit, i.e. take (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to take, receive, be before; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to take, choose, receive; 1a2) to accept; 1a3) to accept, assume; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to show oppositeness; 1b2) to correspond, receive one to the other
